# Awesome GPT Image GIFs

> A curated static gallery of looping AI GIFs and GPT Image 2.6 (ChatGPT Images 2.6 / gpt-image-2.6-sunburst / gpt-image-2.6-flare) use-case prompts. Independent community project, not an OpenAI product.

This repository is static HTML, CSS, and JavaScript on GitHub Pages, plus Python validators. It does not call the Images API at browse time. docs/gifs/ holds repository-seed multi-frame GIFs. Recovered third-party 2.6 GIFs are link-only in docs/data/media-manifest.json (no redistribution license found; bytes not copied). Idea cards mix those GIFs, original SVG concept covers, and link-only third-party examples. X attachments labeled animated_gif usually deliver MP4; they were not watched and are not claimed as .gif files. Morphic prompt-library examples ran on GPT Image 2.5 / Ideogram Vector, not 2.6, and are not in the 2.6 GIF gallery. Prompts are marked verbatim, reconstructed, or empty. Third-party wording and this repo's adaptations are stored separately.

## Pages

- [GIF gallery](https://jammyfu.github.io/awesome-gpt-image-gifs/): searchable local and source-hosted GIF examples
- [Idea playbook](https://jammyfu.github.io/awesome-gpt-image-gifs/ideas.html): sourced use cases with prompts when available
- [Popular GIF remakes](https://jammyfu.github.io/awesome-gpt-image-gifs/popular.html): official-chart remake playbooks, not Image 2.6 works
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/jammyfu/awesome-gpt-image-gifs): source, validators, and contribution guide

## Canonical data

- [docs/data/gallery.json](https://github.com/jammyfu/awesome-gpt-image-gifs/blob/main/docs/data/gallery.json): gallery metadata (local + link-only)
- [docs/data/ideas.json](https://github.com/jammyfu/awesome-gpt-image-gifs/blob/main/docs/data/ideas.json): idea catalog
- [docs/data/media-manifest.json](https://github.com/jammyfu/awesome-gpt-image-gifs/blob/main/docs/data/media-manifest.json): media hashes, formats, rights, exclusions
- [playbooks/ideas-and-prompts.md](https://github.com/jammyfu/awesome-gpt-image-gifs/blob/main/playbooks/ideas-and-prompts.md): full prompts
- [playbooks/sources.md](https://github.com/jammyfu/awesome-gpt-image-gifs/blob/main/playbooks/sources.md): attributed sources
- [playbooks/trends-2026-11.md](https://github.com/jammyfu/awesome-gpt-image-gifs/blob/main/playbooks/trends-2026-11.md): sources dated 2026-11-06 (Beijing time)
- [playbooks/popular-gifs.md](https://github.com/jammyfu/awesome-gpt-image-gifs/blob/main/playbooks/popular-gifs.md): official-chart remakes, not 2.6
- [playbooks/x-catalog.md](https://github.com/jammyfu/awesome-gpt-image-gifs/blob/main/playbooks/x-catalog.md): independently re-checked X playbooks
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/jammyfu/awesome-gpt-image-gifs/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [MEDIA_RIGHTS.md](https://github.com/jammyfu/awesome-gpt-image-gifs/blob/main/MEDIA_RIGHTS.md)
